description: Collecting voice samples from a meeting: who may collect, add, hear and delete.

preconditions: A sample was collected at the meeting; actor is its current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: its current secretary; sampleId: a sample collected there.
cases.return: The decrypted bytes with their content type.
cases.log: Saved: audit row records the play with the owner and the meeting.

preconditions: The sample was collected at another meeting; actor is the current secretary of this one.
cases.inputs: meetingId: this meeting; actorId: its current secretary; sampleId: a sample collected elsewhere.
cases.return: Null; a secretary only hears samples taken in their own meeting.

preconditions: A sample was collected at the meeting; actor takes part but is not the secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: a member who is not the secretary; sampleId: a sample collected there.
cases.return: Null; answered as if the meeting does not exist.
